items.name: POOC Caminha-Espinho — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Caminha-Espinho
items.diploma: RCM n.º 25/99, de 7 de abril; alterado/revisto pela RCM n.º 154/2007, de 2 de outubro
items.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Caminha-Espinho (RCM n.º 111/2021)
items.dataSource: Historical only; superseded geometry in SNIT archive (snit.dgterritorio.gov.pt). Current regime: SNIAmb/POC MapServer (see POC-CE entry).
items.notes: One of the original 9 POOCs. Revision into a POC determined by despacho of 2009.

items.name: POOC Ovar-Marinha Grande — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Ovar-Marinha Grande
items.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Ovar-Marinha Grande (RCM n.º 112/2017)
items.dataSource: Historical only; see POC-OMG entry for current GIS.
items.notes: First POOC to be converted into a Programa da Orla Costeira.

items.name: POOC Alcobaça-Mafra — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Alcobaça-Mafra
items.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel (RCM n.º 66/2019)

items.name: POOC Cidadela-Forte de São Julião da Barra — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Cidadela-São Julião da Barra
items.diploma: RCM n.º 123/98, de 19 de outubro; alterado pelas RCM n.º 82/2012 e RCM n.º 64/2016, de 19 de outubro
items.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel (RCM n.º 66/2019)
items.notes: Shortest POOC (Cascais bay marginal, Cidadela to Forte de S. Julião da Barra).

items.name: POOC Sintra-Sado — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Sintra-Sado
items.status: Revoked in two steps: area north of Cabo Espichel by POC Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel (RCM 66/2019); Espichel-Sado section by POC Espichel-Odeceixe (RCM 87-A/2022). Fully out of force since October 2022.
items.dataSource: Historical only; see POC-ACE and POC-EO entries.
items.notes: Its area was split between two POC troços at Cabo Espichel.

items.name: POOC Sado-Sines — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Sado-Sines
items.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Espichel-Odeceixe (RCM n.º 87-A/2022)

items.name: POOC Sines-Burgau — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Sines-Burgau
items.status: PARTIALLY in force: the Sines-Odeceixe section was replaced by POC Espichel-Odeceixe (RCM 87-A/2022); the Odeceixe-Burgau section remains in force until the POC Odeceixe-Vilamoura is approved (still in elaboration as of mid-2026).
items.dataSource: SNIAmb/POOC MapServer (ArcGIS REST): https://sniambgeoogc.apambiente.pt/getogc/rest/services/SNIAmb/POOC/MapServer (layer 0, fields nome/local/zonamento/tipo; /query supports bbox + f=geojson). Also SNIT viewer and APA page https://apambiente.pt/agua/pooc-sines-burgau (plantas síntese/condicionantes, planos de praia).
items.notes: IMPORTANT overlap for pdm: this entire stretch lies inside the Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina — the POPNSACV (RCM n.º 11-B/2011, de 4 de fevereiro) applies concurrently; municipal PDMs transpose both regimes.

items.name: POOC Burgau-Vilamoura — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Burgau-Vilamoura
items.status: STILL IN FORCE (em vigor) — will be replaced by POC Odeceixe-Vilamoura, which is still in elaboration as of mid-2026
items.dataSource: SNIAmb/POOC MapServer (ArcGIS REST): https://sniambgeoogc.apambiente.pt/getogc/rest/services/SNIAmb/POOC/MapServer; SNIT viewer; APA POOC pages with plantas and planos de praia.
items.notes: One of only two POOCs still fully in force.

items.name: POOC Vilamoura-Vila Real de Santo António — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Vilamoura-Vila Real de Santo António
items.diploma: RCM n.º 103/2005, de 27 de junho; 1.ª alteração pela RCM n.º 65/2016, de 19 de outubro (regulamento arts. 3, 4, 23, 55, 58-61, 67-77, 93, 95 + planta síntese)
items.status: STILL IN FORCE (em vigor) — replacement POC-VVRSA has not effectively started (PCGT: 'a aguardar atribuição')
items.dataSource: SNIAmb/POOC MapServer (ArcGIS REST): https://sniambgeoogc.apambiente.pt/getogc/rest/services/SNIAmb/POOC/MapServer; SNIT viewer; beach-plan fichas on dados.gov.pt (search 'POOC Vilamoura').
items.notes: Covers the Ria Formosa barrier-island coast; overlaps the Parque Natural da Ria Formosa special plan (POPNRF).

items.name: POC-CE — Programa da Orla Costeira Caminha-Espinho
items.status: Em vigor (in force). Revokes POOC Caminha-Espinho (RCM 25/99 + RCM 154/2007).
items.dataSource: APA SNIAmb ArcGIS REST (verified live): https://sniambgeoogc.apambiente.pt/getogc/rest/services/SNIAmb/POC/MapServer — 24 layers incl. Área de intervenção (0), Praia marítima (5), Faixas de salvaguarda erosão/galgamento (9-12), Zona Terrestre de Proteção (16), Zona Marítima de Proteção (17). OGC WMS 1.3.0 at https://sniambgeoogc.apambiente.pt/getogc/services/SNIAmb/POC/MapServer/WMSServer. Also SNIAmb geo-visualizador (sniamb.apambiente.pt/content/geo-visualizador), SNIT, and INSPIRE record 'POC - Faixas de Salvaguarda'.
items.notes: 122 km of coast, 9 municipalities, 36 freguesias. As a 'programa' it binds public entities; its faixas de salvaguarda and beach regulations were transposed into PDMs (e.g. PDM Caminha alteration, Aviso 22303/2021).

items.name: POC-OMG — Programa da Orla Costeira Ovar-Marinha Grande
items.diploma: RCM n.º 112/2017, de 10 de agosto; Regulamento de Gestão das Praias Marítimas: Aviso n.º 11506/2017, de 29 de setembro; updated by Despacho n.º 4034/2024, de 12 de abril
items.status: Em vigor (in force). Revokes POOC Ovar-Marinha Grande (RCM 142/2000). First POC approved.
items.dataSource: Same APA SNIAmb/POC MapServer + WMS as POC-CE (single national service, filter by area/attributes). Beach plans on dados.gov.pt and apambiente.pt.

items.name: POC-ACE — Programa da Orla Costeira Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel
items.diploma: RCM n.º 66/2019, de 11 de abril; Regulamento de Gestão das Praias: Aviso n.º 12492/2019, de 6 de agosto
items.status: Em vigor (in force). Revokes POOC Alcobaça-Mafra, POOC Cidadela-S. Julião da Barra, and POOC Sintra-Sado in the POC-ACE area.
items.dataSource: APA SNIAmb/POC MapServer + WMS (see POC-CE). SNIT for published plantas.
items.notes: 224 km across 12 municipalities. The Tejo estuary margin (Oeiras/Lisboa) is outside POC scope — it awaits the never-approved Tejo estuary program.

items.name: POC-EO — Programa da Orla Costeira Espichel-Odeceixe
items.diploma: RCM n.º 87-A/2022, de 4 de outubro; retificada pela Declaração de Retificação n.º 26/2022, de 17 de outubro; Regulamento de Gestão das Praias: Aviso n.º 23368/2022, de 12 de dezembro
items.status: Em vigor (in force). Revises/replaces POOC Sintra-Sado (Espichel-Sado section), POOC Sado-Sines (whole), and POOC Sines-Burgau (Sines-Odeceixe section).
items.dataSource: APA SNIAmb/POC MapServer + WMS (see POC-CE); participa.pt consultation archive; APA page apambiente.pt/agua/programa-da-orla-costeira-espichel-odeceixe.
items.notes: ~476 km², 220 km of coast, 15 freguesias. Overlaps PNSACV between Porto Covo and Odeceixe, where POPNSACV (RCM 11-B/2011) also applies.

items.name: POC-OV — Programa da Orla Costeira Odeceixe-Vilamoura
items.diploma: Not approved. Elaboration resumed by Despacho n.º 9316/2019, de 3 de outubro (SEOT/Conservação da Natureza); earlier proposal had public discussion 7 jun–19 jul 2016
items.status: Em elaboração (in elaboration, NOT in force) as of mid-2026 — PCGT phase 'determinação do início', no public-discussion or approval dates set. Until approved, POOC Sines-Burgau (Odeceixe-Burgau section), POOC Burgau-Vilamoura and POPNSACV remain the applicable regimes.
items.dataSource: Draft documents (2016 proposal, planos de praia) on apambiente.pt and participa.pt; tracking on PCGT: https://pcgt.dgterritorio.gov.pt/node/12814. No in-force GIS layer yet.
items.notes: ~509 km², 210 km of coast. Will merge POOC Sines-Burgau (Odeceixe-Burgau) + POOC Burgau-Vilamoura. Status can change — CCDR Algarve/AMAL announced a 'retoma'; re-check PCGT before shipping.

items.name: POC-VVRSA — Programa da Orla Costeira Vilamoura-Vila Real de Santo António
items.diploma: Not approved. Elaboration determined by Despacho n.º 3841/2017, de 8 de maio
items.status: Not started substantively — PCGT phase 'a aguardar atribuição' (awaiting assignment) as of mid-2026. POOC Vilamoura-VRSA (RCM 103/2005, alt. RCM 65/2016) remains in force.
items.dataSource: Tracking on PCGT: https://pcgt.dgterritorio.gov.pt/node/1403. No GIS layer.

items.name: POE Tejo — Plano de Ordenamento do Estuário do Tejo
items.diploma: Never approved. Elaboration determined by Despacho n.º 21020/2009, de 18 de setembro (competence to ARH do Tejo), under Decreto-Lei n.º 129/2008, de 21 de julho (regime dos planos de ordenamento dos estuários)
items.status: NOT in force — only a preliminary proposal was ever produced; no approving RCM exists. Under Lei 31/2014/DL 80/2015 it would now be elaborated as a 'programa de estuário' (APA lists it as planned).
items.dataSource: No plan GIS. Estuary constraints today come from Reserva Natural do Estuário do Tejo (ICNF), domínio hídrico, PGRH Tejo e Oeste (APA/SNIAmb).
items.notes: For pdm: do NOT model any POE as an active constraint layer.

items.name: POE Douro — Plano de Ordenamento do Estuário do Douro
items.diploma: Never approved. Elaboration determined 2008/2009 under DL 129/2008; technical proposal advanced by ARH do Norte but no approving diploma was ever published in the DRE
items.status: NOT in force. APA now lists a future 'Programa de Estuário' for the Douro; nothing approved as of mid-2026. (APA's own page is ambiguous — documents/studies exist, but there is no approving RCM.)
items.dataSource: No plan GIS. Related in-force instrument: Reserva Natural Local do Estuário do Douro (Regulamento n.º 415/2018, de 10 de julho — municipal/ICNF data).

items.name: POE Vouga — Plano/Programa de Ordenamento do Estuário do Vouga
items.diploma: None — never formally elaborated or approved
items.status: NOT in force; listed by APA only as a planned future 'Programa de Estuário' (Vouga/Ria de Aveiro)
items.notes: APA's planned estuary-program list is Douro, Mondego, Vouga, Tejo — the Mondego is also planned and equally unapproved. Zero estuary plans/programs are in force in Portugal.

summary: Complete inventory as of mid-2026. Coastal: 9 original POOCs; the coast was re-divided into 6 POC troços, of which 4 are approved and in force (POC-OMG RCM 112/2017; POC-ACE RCM 66/2019; POC-CE RCM 111/2021; POC-EO RCM 87-A/2022 + retif. 26/2022) and 2 are unapproved (POC Odeceixe-Vilamoura in elaboration since Despacho 9316/2019, POC Vilamoura-VRSA awaiting assignment since Despacho 3841/2017). Consequently 6 POOCs are fully revoked; 3 survive in the Algarve/SW: POOC Sines-Burgau (only its Odeceixe-Burgau section), POOC Burgau-Vilamoura, and POOC Vilamoura-VRSA (as altered by RCM 65/2016). Estuaries: the POE regime exists (DL 129/2008) and elaboration was launched for Tejo (Despacho 21020/2009) and Douro, with Vouga and Mondego merely planned, but NO estuary plan/program was ever approved — none is in force, so pdm should not model POE layers. Key GIS finding (verified live): APA publishes machine-readable layers at https://sniambgeoogc.apambiente.pt/getogc/rest/services/ — SNIAmb/POC/MapServer (24 layers: área de intervenção, praias, faixas de salvaguarda erosão/galgamento, zonas terrestre/marítima de proteção) and SNIAmb/POOC/MapServer (fields nome/local/zonamento/tipo), both also as OGC WMS 1.3.0 (.../getogc/services/SNIAmb/POC/MapServer/WMSServer); ArcGIS REST /query supports bbox/attribute filters and f=geojson, i.e. the same client pattern pdm already uses for Tomar's municipal ArcGIS. The same APA server hosts SNIAmb/POAAP/MapServer (albufeira plans, useful for the POACB workstream). Caveats: POC-OV municipalities differ slightly between APA (7, without Loulé) and PCGT (8, with Loulé); APA's estuary page ambiguously implies a Douro POE document exists — studies/proposals exist but no approving diploma is in the DRE; POC-OV status may change soon (CCDR Algarve announced a retoma) — re-check PCGT nodes 12814/1403 before release. Overlap warning: on the Costa Vicentina and Ria Formosa stretches the still-in-force POOCs coexist with POPNSACV (RCM 11-B/2011) and POPNRF respectively.
